flags.observation: Intro runs four onboarding beats after beat 1; spec allows one to three.
Dog whistles are announced ("Wrestling nerds, watch for") rather than embedded; the promised "ref bump" is never sung in any card line.
"cheap heat for opponent" reads as the power rule restated, with the game-table word opponent.
Cutting the card's last word leaves "The Jewish Physician" next to "it's a crime"; reads as an accusation against a named group.
"enforcer destroys corruption" recites the power effect as a rule, not as aside or inversion.
"witty verse boosts faces" is the stat-boost power paraphrased as a rule.
"the bell, if King orders it" is a rule condition with a dropped article; 103 characters with opener, past one breath.
Tail stubs like "clue", "rage", "audit", "filibuster" end lines as power-label tags; recurring list cadence flattens the delivery.
"damage intended for another" recites the scapegoat power mechanic verbatim minus one word.
"Bizarro sell" compresses a game effect into an opaque term; closure lost for listeners.
105 characters including opener; together with beats 12 and 18, several spoken lines exceed one breath versus the golden.
Style A asks for a female talk-sing voice while beat 2 has the narrator say "I'm Uncle FrizzleBob"; voice and speaker clash.
